items.prompt: A row decision was at 11, but its target label became available at 18. May it train a model frozen at 15?

options.why: The future target outcome was still unavailable.

options.text: Yes, if it improves the final test score
options.why: A favorable score does not grant earlier knowledge.

options.text: Only if the row is sorted first
options.why: Sort order does not change timestamp availability.

options.text: No; the label was unavailable at fitting
options.why: It can become eligible at a later justified fit snapshot.

items.explanation: Training must use information available to that fitting process, including label-availability time rather than just row-decision time.
